headline: K-Pop Groups BIGBANG And Kiss Of Life Announce New Music Releases
seoTitle: BIGBANG and Kiss of Life Announce New Digital Singles
metaDescription: Iconic K-pop group BIGBANG has launched their latest digital single, while girl group Kiss of Life revealed teasers for an upcoming winter track.
aiSummaryBullets: The K-pop boy group BIGBANG officially released their new digital single titled GiiiRIP.
Girl group Kiss of Life unveiled teaser photos for their first winter-themed single, Greedy.
Kiss of Life is scheduled to release their new two-track project this coming Wednesday.
aiContextParagraph: The South Korean music industry is currently seeing new activity from two prominent K-pop acts. The long-standing boy group BIGBANG has made a comeback by dropping their latest digital single, GiiiRIP. Meanwhile, the girl group Kiss of Life is preparing for the release of their first winter-season song, titled Greedy. According to their agency, S2 Entertainment, the group shared teaser images featuring the band members in a domestic setting to promote the launch. This upcoming release follows the group’s third single album, Sweat, which was released approximately four months ago. The new project from Kiss of Life will consist of two tracks and is scheduled to debut on Wednesday. These updates reflect the continued output from major K-pop artists as they engage with seasonal promotional cycles and digital music distribution platforms within the competitive domestic and international entertainment markets.
whyItIsViral: This story is circulating due to reports from two independent media outlets regarding anticipated music releases from major K-pop artists.
